# Anna's Garden Hotel — Tbilisi, Georgia

Official website: https://annas-garden-hotel.vercel.app
Booking: https://www.booking.com/hotel/ge/annas-garden.html
Address: 10 Shalva Mshvelidze Street, 0190 Tbilisi, Georgia
Phone: +995 599 52 17 51

## Summary
Anna's Garden Hotel is a small modern hotel in Tbilisi with bright guest rooms, private bathrooms, air conditioning, soundproofing, free Wi-Fi and free private parking. Main amenities include a 24-hour front desk, airport shuttle, room service, non-smoking rooms, heating, garden and laundry service.

## Rooms
- Deluxe Double Room: about 24 m² / 258 ft², queen bed, balcony, private bathroom, air conditioning, soundproofing, free Wi-Fi.
- Deluxe Twin Room: about 19 m², two beds, private bathroom, air conditioning, soundproofing, free Wi-Fi.
- Economy Double Room: about 15 m² / 161 ft², full bed, garden or inner-courtyard view, private bathroom, air conditioning, soundproofing, free Wi-Fi.

## Guest information
- Check-in: 14:00–00:00
- Check-out: 10:00–12:00
- Children: welcome
- Pets: not allowed
- Free private parking: available
- Free Wi-Fi: available
